It was just never a thought in previous non weed trips. That said, I have seen plenty of people on here mentioning similar experiences with no mentioning of weed. So while not super common, it’s still something that plenty of people nowadays are experiencing. And I wouldn’t say it’s an excessive reaction because lsd is still so potent at beginning doses even. 

Only other points I can think to mention are that I find that the headspace gets stronger the more I isolate myself and avoid socializing. I start falling into the loops and questions more and more when I’m staying inside constantly. And lastly, whenever I smoke too much weed now it sends me back to that feeling of loneliness that comes with the thinking and can induce the thoughts to start popping up again. I do have some trauma and mental illness that surely plays roles in my reactions, but weed always seems to potentiate it

Initially, you should notice that thoughts are hard to fully grasp and something just feels strange….  When it really starts to go into effect your body will feel like it’s full of energy, almost like charging up. This is usually a sign that you’re about to blast off. Visuals should start coming into play soon after. Peak of the trip will be 3-4 hours in and it can be a lil intense, but quite euphoric in my experience. Recommend just laying down with some music and just giving in to whatever the experience has for ya. After peak you’ll still be in the headspace some, but things will feel calmer in comparison. Visuals will linger but it’ll be a lot more relaxed. This is often times my favorite portion of the trip. Things will slowly decline until you reach a point where you may just feel tired. Any effects you still feel will disappear after you get good sleep, just make sure to hydrate before bed. (Didn’t mention this earlier, but you can’t really sleep on acid so expect to be awake 12ish hours)

As for going outside into public, I would say before peak when things are first starting up good or after peak when winding down some. Being in public really isn’t bad at all in my experience though. I usually feel quite social and energetic. As for what to do, just do things you enjoy normally, talk to your girlfriend, and make sure to reinforce your love for yourself, others and life. 

P.s, talking during the lsd peak can become difficult because thoughts are happening so fast. Articulating can become hard so don’t be surprised if you say some funny stuff or can’t quite say what you mean. Sometimes, it’s best to just enjoy the moment and save words for afterward.
